                            Table "public.gen_tbl"
 Column |  Type   | Collation | Nullable |              Default               
--------+---------+-----------+----------+------------------------------------
 a      | integer |           |          | 
 b      | integer |           |          | generated always as (a * 2)
 c      | integer |           |          | generated always as (a + 1) stored
Check constraints:
    "gen_chk" CHECK (a > 0) NOT ENFORCED
